test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following are the founders of the Indian startup Zepto, who have emerged as the youngest billionaires in India according to the 2024 Hurun Rich List?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaivalya Vohra and Aadit Palicha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kaivalya Vohra** and **Aadit Palicha** are the founders of the Indian startup Zepto.
 
• Zepto is a fast-growing grocery delivery service in India.
 
• According to the 2024 Hurun Rich List, they have emerged as the youngest billionaires in India.
 
• Both founders are under the age of 25, making significant strides in the Indian startup ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zepto**:

 
 
• Zepto is a grocery delivery startup that promises delivery within 10 minutes.
 
• Founded in 2021, it has rapidly expanded its services across multiple Indian cities.
 
 
 
• **Hurun Rich List**:
 
 
• The Hurun Rich List is an annual ranking of the wealthiest individuals in a particular country or globally.
 
• It provides insights into the wealth distribution and economic trends among the elite.
 
 
 
• **Startup Ecosystem in India**:
 
 
• India has become one of the fastest-growing startup ecosystems in the world.
 
• It ranks third globally in terms of the number of startups, after the USA and China.
 
 
 
• **Young Entrepreneurs**:
 
 
• Young entrepreneurs are increasingly making significant impacts in various sectors, including technology, e-commerce, and fintech.
 
• They bring innovative solutions and new business models that disrupt traditional industries.
